node.label: BevyNativeProductAssembly
node.responsibility: Compose one game-specific engine-independent Rust rule machine with upstream Bevy ECS, Plugin, input, sprite and text systems
node.authority: Game product rules owner; Bevy upstream engine owns ECS, renderer, schedules and input
outputs: bounded Rust rule and Bevy system test evidence
node.behavioralContract: Goal collection, hazard damage and restart are game-owned transitions; Bevy-native systems consume those rules. Cargo compile and test do not prove rendered GPU output or human enjoyment. Native FixedUpdate advances movement, collection and hazard rules while Update owns restart input and HUD; frame rate may change how many fixed steps occur in one rendered frame.
